description: This file defines the LeaveCommentSearchFilterParams class, which extends a DateRangeSearchFilterParams class. It provides filtering parameters specifically for searching leave comments, including a leaveId property and sorting capabilities based on comment creation date.

classes.name: LeaveCommentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for filtering leave comment searches, including date range and leave ID, with sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'leaveComment.createdAt'.

methods.name: getLeaveId
methods.description: Returns the leave ID filter value, or null if not set.

methods.name: setLeaveId
methods.description: Sets the leave ID filter value.
